tasks.label: UI Mod: Build + Hot Reload (ScriptEngine)
tasks.detail: Builds Assets/Scripts/StationeersUIMod (+ dev ScriptEngine shim) and drops StationeersUIMod.dll into BepInEx\scripts. Press F6 in game, or wait ~3s for the watcher.

tasks.label: UI Mod: Clean ScriptEngine deploy
tasks.detail: Removes StationeersUIMod.dll from BepInEx\scripts (stops ScriptEngine loading it).
tasks.command: Remove-Item 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers\BepInEx\scripts\StationeersUIMod.dll' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Cleared StationeersUIMod.dll from BepInEx\scripts'

tasks.label: Legacy ImGui POC: Build + Hot Reload
tasks.detail: DEPRECATED. The old BepInEx-only project (StationeersUIAscended). Kept for reference; do not run alongside the Unity mod - both would patch the same methods.
tasks.command: dotnet build -c Debug; if ($?) { Copy-Item 'bin\Debug\StationeersUIAscended.dll' 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stationeers\BepInEx\scripts\' -Force; Write-Host 'DEPRECATED build deployed. Remove StationeersUIMod.dll from scripts first!' }
